proof_steps: Exact coefficients and target define F=N-target*S. S>=1, so F zeros are exactly the prescribed normalized outputs.
The fixed rational center lies in convex compact X. The mean-value derivative gives T(X) subset K(X) for T(v)=v-CF(v).
Strict K inside X gives a self-map; uniform infinity-norm(I-CJ_F)<1 gives contraction. Banach ensures a unique fixed point in X.
Norm<1 implies CJ_F and hence square C and J_F are nonsingular. A fixed point is exactly a zero of F; all F zeros in X are fixed points.
At a zero J_observables=J_F/S, hence local rank5. Independent exact target derivative intervals also give rank5.
Strict positive populations/nonzero amplitudes put the X root in the ideal admissible domain. Its x and M1 fraction exclude the target chart/gauge.
The exact target and certified X root share all five outputs, so the unknown-population map is noninjective; there may be additional roots.

Approximate search/inverse values are quantized once to terminating exact rational constants. C need not be an exact inverse. Independent center/C and box-radius facts are true.

K encloses T(X), with exact x0 in convex X. K strictly inside X and norm<1 give a self-map contraction and one fixed point. Norm also gives nonsingular C, so that fixed point is exactly a zero of F. Uniqueness is only in X.

Norm<1 implies J_F nonsingular throughout X. At the exact zero, J_obs=J_F/S has rank5. Independent target normalized determinant also excludes zero. Do not assert the normalized derivative identity away from a zero.
Exact interval bounds show p0,p1,p2 positive everywhere in X and x,y,z exclude0; fixed aM1=1. This proves admissibility in the stated ideal density/amplitude domain.

One exact target and one exact root in a distinct box share the same five outputs. x and invariant M1 fraction exclusions prove they are not common scale/sign copies. This proves the five-variable map is globally noninjective, not classification/count of all roots.
New p0/p1 differ from target1/4,1/4. The counterexample is for jointly unknown population and amplitudes; it does not transfer to a population-known three-variable slice.
Equal A2,A4 give the same W1 at theta1. Independent exact sqrt bounds show this target W1>0, so equality of W12 also gives equal W12/W1 here without adding a sixth independent datum.
